data.one_liner: Dart template generator for quick file creation
data.what_it_does: Mason provides a core generator that can be used to build custom code generation tools. It loads bricks from local or Git sources and renders templates with variables. The generated files are written to a target directory.
use_when: You need to generate boilerplate files consistently across a team
You want to create custom generators for your own project structure
You are already using mason_cli and want to extend it with custom bricks
avoid_when: You need runtime UI generation or dynamic widget creation
You are building a library that requires runtime code execution
strengths: Supports Git bricks and local bricks
Hook system for pre/post generation logic
weaknesses: Only for file generation, not runtime code
data.setup_notes: Add mason to pubspec, import mason, create a Brick, call MasonGenerator.fromBrick, and generate to a DirectoryGeneratorTarget
